تغتصبون (form VIII)
# تَغْتَصِبُونَ (taḡtaṣibūna) /taɣ.ta.sˤi.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# تُغْتَصَبُونَ (tuḡtaṣabūna) /tuɣ.ta.sˤa.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
